verdict.rationale: Docs confirm mobile-specific crash tooling (dSYM upload for iOS, ProGuard mapping upload for Android) implying native crash symbolication support, and general crash reporting captures stack trace/environment/version data (docs-1, docs-8/23). However there's no explicit mention of NDK (native C/C++) crash handling, and no dedicated documentation of device/OS/app-version context capture specific to mobile SDKs. Missing for 10: explicit NDK native crash support, mobile-specific device/OS/app-version context documentation, independent/hands-on corroboration of mobile crash capture.
